references.text: Paul speaks about how not all who are of Israel are true Israelites, pointing back to Jesus' words that knowing God does not come from human origin but through revelation from God.
God reveals Himself to those who did not seek Him; this can be seen as a parallel to God's revelation to Peter, which was not based on human wisdom.
The Lord reveals His secrets to His prophets, which can be viewed as a precursor to the revelation Peter received.
God reveals His covenant to those who fear Him, reflecting the idea that God's revelations are not accessible through human effort but through divine choice.
Jesus thanks the Father for hiding these things from the wise and understanding and revealing them to little children, which is similar to how Peter received his revelation.
